stories.title: View account summary
stories.narrative: As a customer service agent, I want to view an account's balance, limits and linked customer so that I can answer customer queries.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Given a valid account id, the summary returns current balance, credit limit and cash limit.
Given an unknown account id, the API returns 404 'Account not found'.
The linked customer's name and address come from the customer record.

stories.title: Update account details
stories.narrative: As an account administrator, I want to update credit limits and account status with validation so that account data stays consistent.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A credit limit below the current balance is rejected.
Account status accepts only 'Y' (active) or 'N' (inactive).
A successful update persists and returns the updated record.

codegen.rationale: Attempt 1 failed ArchUnit (controller → repository); repair routed through AccountUpdateService.

stories.title: Batch account export
stories.narrative: As operations, I want the account file export to run on the new platform so that downstream reports keep working.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every account record is written with the same layout as the COBOL OUTFILE.
COMP-3 amounts are exported with identical scale and sign.

warnings: COBOL behavior-model signals are not represented in generated files

codegen.rationale: Maven/JDK unavailable on host: accepted as generated-unverified.

stories.title: Validate daily transactions
stories.narrative: As the posting batch, I want each daily transaction validated against its card and account so that invalid transactions are rejected before posting.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A card number with no cross-reference is rejected with reason 100.
A transaction exceeding the credit limit is rejected with reason 102.
A transaction after account expiry is rejected with reason 103.

stories.title: Post transactions & update balances
stories.narrative: As the posting batch, I want valid transactions posted and account and category balances updated so that balances match the legacy system.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Posting a transaction adds its amount to the account's current balance.
A category balance record is created on first use and accumulated afterwards.
Each posted transaction is written to the transaction file.

failures: COBOL behavior-model signals are not represented in generated files

codegen.rationale: CategoryBalanceTest: no record created on first posting (COBOL 2700-A-CREATE-TCATBAL-REC on INVALID KEY). Repair attempt 2 of 3 running.

stories.title: List transactions with paging
stories.narrative: As a customer service agent, I want to browse an account's transactions page by page so that I can investigate disputes.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Transactions are returned 10 per page.
Paging past the last page returns an empty page, not an error.

stories.title: List cards for an account
stories.narrative: As a customer service agent, I want to list all cards linked to an account so that I can pick the one a customer is calling about.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: All cards cross-referenced to the account are returned, filtered as on the CICS screen.

stories.title: View card details
stories.narrative: As a customer service agent, I want to view a card's status, expiry and embossed name so that I can verify the cardholder.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Card details are returned for a valid account + card pair; unknown cards return 404.

stories.title: Update card status & expiry
stories.narrative: As an account administrator, I want to update a card's status and expiry date with validation so that lost or renewed cards are handled.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Expiry month must be 1–12 and the expiry year must be valid.
Card status accepts only 'Y' or 'N'.

ask.question: Which programs write to the account file?
ask.answer: COACTUPC (online update), CBTRN02C (posting, 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC) and COBIL00C (bill payment) write ACCTDAT/ACCTFILE. CBACT01C only reads it.

ask.question: What makes a daily transaction get rejected?
ask.answer: 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN rejects when the card has no cross-reference (100), the account is not found (101), the credit limit is exceeded (102) or the account has expired (103). Rejects go to DALYREJS.

ask.question: Which screens only read data?
ask.answer: COACTVWC (account view), COCRDLIC (card list), COCRDSLC (card detail) and COTRN00C (transaction list) have no writes — good first seams.
